name.zh: 体重与中心性肥胖管理

core_message.zh: 当前BMI达到本原型的体重管理关注条件；建议结合专业评估讨论生活方式管理。
core_message.en: Your BMI meets this prototype's weight-management attention criterion. Discuss lifestyle management with a healthcare professional as appropriate.

zh: 优先从饮食结构、总能量摄入和规律身体活动三个方面开展体重管理。
建议采用能够长期坚持的健康饮食方式，避免极端节食或短期快速减重。
对于超重或肥胖且糖代谢风险较高的人群，可将初始体重减少约5%–7%作为阶段性健康管理目标。
en: Prioritize weight management through dietary quality, appropriate energy intake, and regular physical activity.
Choose a sustainable healthy eating pattern and avoid extreme dieting or rapid short-term weight loss.
For individuals with overweight or obesity and elevated metabolic risk, an initial weight reduction of approximately 5%–7% may be considered as a staged health-management goal.

source.zh: 参考：ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026
source.en: Reference: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026

blood_pressure_management.applicable_population: Adults eligible for the ZhiJian research screening prototype; one entered blood-pressure reading

source_reference.zh: 待核查：2025 AHA/ACC High Blood Pressure Guideline（现有来源名称，未核对具体条款）
source_reference.en: To verify: 2025 AHA/ACC High Blood Pressure Guideline (existing source name; specific provision unverified)

core_message.zh: 血压升高可能增加整体代谢及心血管健康风险。
core_message.en: Elevated blood pressure may increase overall metabolic and cardiovascular health risk.

zh: 建议在安静状态下规范复测血压，并记录多次测量结果。
关注体重、膳食盐摄入、身体活动、睡眠等可调整健康因素。
若多次血压仍明显升高，建议咨询医疗专业人员进一步评估。
en: Repeat blood pressure measurements under standardized resting conditions and record multiple readings.
Pay attention to modifiable factors such as body weight, dietary sodium intake, physical activity, and sleep.
If blood pressure remains elevated on repeated measurements, consider further evaluation by a healthcare professional.

source.zh: 参考：2025 AHA/ACC High Blood Pressure Guideline
source.en: Reference: 2025 AHA/ACC High Blood Pressure Guideline

source_reference.en: To verify: WHO Physical Activity Guidelines / GPAQ (existing source name; specific provision unverified)

core_message.zh: 身体活动不足是可以通过生活方式调整改善的重要健康因素。
core_message.en: Insufficient physical activity is an important modifiable health factor.

zh: 逐步增加日常身体活动，并减少长时间连续久坐。
可逐渐达到每周至少150分钟中等强度身体活动，或相应等量的高强度活动。
根据自身情况选择快走、骑行、游泳等更容易长期坚持的活动方式。
en: Gradually increase daily physical activity and reduce prolonged uninterrupted sedentary time.
Work toward at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity activity per week, or an equivalent amount of vigorous-intensity activity.
Choose sustainable activities such as brisk walking, cycling, or swimming according to personal ability and preference.

source.zh: 参考：WHO Physical Activity Guidelines / GPAQ
source.en: Reference: WHO Physical Activity Guidelines / GPAQ

source_reference.en: To verify: general preventive health and smoking-cessation guidance (existing source label; no specific citation)

core_message.zh: 当前吸烟是重要的可干预健康危险因素。
core_message.en: Current smoking is an important modifiable health risk factor.

zh: 建议制定清晰、可执行的戒烟计划。
尽量减少诱发吸烟的环境和情境暴露，并建立替代行为。
如自行戒烟困难，可寻求专业戒烟支持或医疗专业人员帮助。
en: Develop a clear and achievable smoking-cessation plan.
Reduce exposure to situations that trigger smoking and establish healthier replacement behaviors.
If quitting independently is difficult, consider professional smoking-cessation support or guidance from a healthcare professional.

source.zh: 参考：一般预防健康与戒烟指导
source.en: Reference: General preventive health and smoking-cessation guidance
